scope: Targeted finite seed search with actual traced optional-organ precursor; not autonomous occurrence frequency, full tissue-cost validity or completed player progression.

policy.stoppingRule: Stop after the first actual ordinary newborn whose accepted deletion operator removes both storage organs from its recombined precursor; archive all earlier attempted seeds and all siblings. Untested remaining seeds are not outcomes.
policy.interventions: Targeted counterfactual worlds import the exact recorded mature organism8 as a disclosed precursor (source parentage retained, no invented ancestor). Targets/velocity clear for the new environment; no candidate age/body/genome/reserve reset. One unrelated simple adult mate is initialized at age32, opposite sex,90% energy/hydration and zero cooldown. Pair placement uses existing supported habitat. These are explicit starting fixtures, not in-game migration or ordinary young-world frequency. No later food/reserve additions, acceptance retry, accelerated development, forced RNG or mutation boost.
